description: Pricing plan card with tier name, price, feature list, and choose/current CTA used in the subscription plan selection screen.

tier.description: Plan tier name e.g. Starter, Growth, Pro

monthlyPrice.description: Monthly billing price in the given currency

annualPrice.description: Annual billing price per month equivalent in the given currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for price display

features.description: List of feature strings shown with check icons

isCurrent.description: When true, renders an accent border and disables the CTA

onChoose.description: Callback when owner selects this plan

anatomy: container (radius 2xl 24, padding 24, shadow-sm, current: 2px solid accent border)

sizes.name: default
sizes.note: CTA height; card height is content-driven
